text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought an injured Orfevre
to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Nothing serious.
...Still, overconfidence is forbidden.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Normal training is suspended.
Understood?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Naturally.
It is the innate talent of a king, after all.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Still, sitting completely still will only make my body go stiff.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I order you. Devise a training menu
with a lighter load. ...And make it quick.
choice_data_list: Let's err on the side of caution and take a break here...!
Got it. I'll give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...You.
Are you refusing a royal decree?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reflexively flinch at her intimidating presence.
However, if there's even the slightest chance of her injury worsening...
choice_data_list: That is my decision as your Trainer...!
That is my decision as your Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
That, too, is a form of amusement.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Will your proposal bring fortune or folly...?
This should be quite a spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre stayed quiet and rested
until her injury was fully healed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, we trained carefully
to avoid worsening the injury, but...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmph, did I misjudge?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Do not panic.
...Let us make haste and return."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
We will focus on resting for a while.
Understood?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre's injury worsened...
She had no choice but to rest until it was fully healed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From then on, Orfevre trained
with great caution.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Phew—
choice_data_list: We should be just fine with this!
We should be just fine with this!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: For the time being, I suppose I should dedicate myself to this training.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Not a bad performance.
Continue to apply yourself diligently.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre exercised within reasonable limits
and made a smooth, steady recovery.
